diagnosis.summary: John Doyle is correctly listed as Director on both Sweeney Todd (2005) and The Color Purple (2015) in the show data, but his director profile page is likely not linking back to those shows.
diagnosis.whatsHappening: Looking at the actual show data, John Doyle IS properly credited as 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design' on Sweeney Todd (2005) and 'Director, Scenic Design' on The Color Purple (2015). The problem is almost certainly on the other end: the page that lists all of John Doyle's credits (his director profile page) is not picking up these two shows. This is likely because his role strings contain extra text beyond just 'Director' — they read 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design' and 'Director, Scenic Design' — and the profile page logic probably only matches people whose role is exactly 'Director', missing anyone with a combined role.

submitter.name: Mark Uhl
submitter.message: I noticed a number of errors in the Directors lists (for example, John Doyle is missing both Sweeney Todd and The Color Purple on his list of credits).  Would you like a list of all the errors that I can find or will you go back and check?  Cool site btw and thanks.

plan.summary: John Doyle's role strings in two shows include extra text beyond 'Director' (e.g., 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design'), which likely causes his profile page to miss those credits. The fix splits his combined roles into separate entries so the director lookup works correctly while preserving his design credits.
steps: Split John Doyle's role in sweeney-todd-2005 from 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design' into two separate creativeTeam entries: one for 'Director' and one for 'Scenic & Costume Design'
Split John Doyle's role in the-color-purple-2015 from 'Director, Scenic Design' into two separate creativeTeam entries: one for 'Director' and one for 'Scenic Design'

actions.description: Split John Doyle's combined 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design' role into two separate entries so that exact-match director lookups can find him on his profile page while his design credit is still preserved

Split John Doyle's combined 'Director, Scenic Design' role into two separate entries so that exact-match director lookups can find him on his profile page while his scenic design credit is still preserved
Validate the updated show data to confirm no structural issues were introduced by the creativeTeam changes

issues: The proposed fix for Sweeney Todd (2005) is correct regarding John Doyle's role as 'Director, Scenic & Costume Design', but the fix incorrectly splits this into 'Scenic & Costume Design' instead of just 'Scenic Design'.

The proposed fix for The Color Purple (2015) is correct regarding John Doyle's role as 'Director, Scenic Design', but the fix incorrectly splits this into 'Scenic Design' instead of just 'Scenic Design'.
